note: Derived reading aid. Never authoritative; never read as intent (Decision 0004). The Plan document governs.
author: Lightweight model draft for Clara (technical writing) via Claudia Atlas <claudia.atlas@agents.arcadia.local>
title: Run one launched action to completion, observably
purpose: Lets the operator launch one Action as a session from the dashboard and have it run to a recorded outcome. Sessions run without a terminal screen, leave a full record, and stop automatically if they get stuck.
serves: The Project outcome of Arcadia driving a coding agent to a reported result.
done_when: One Action launched from the session board runs to a draft pull request with its live log and exit recorded, proved end to end offline and then live three times in a row.

actions.title: Run launched sessions without a screen, with a full record
actions.why: A session left in an interactive window cannot be watched reliably or recorded in full.
actions.done_when: Sessions the operator launches run without the interactive screen, and their full output and exit are kept.

actions.title: Stop a stuck session automatically
actions.why: A stuck session should not hold the repository lock indefinitely.
actions.done_when: Each session has a time limit from policy, and a blocking condition ends it without deleting its worktree or branch, so the work so far is kept.

actions.title: Let one confirmed launch run to completion
actions.why: A confirmed launch should finish with its work kept and its outcome recorded, even with production switched off.
actions.done_when: A confirmed launch of one Action records a one-time permission for that Action and session, which expires after 24 hours or on first use, and the outcome is recorded.

actions.title: Prove the single-session path offline
actions.why: A quick offline proof catches breakages on every change, without spending on live runs.
actions.done_when: A rehearsal runs one Action through the same production code in a real terminal session, and injected failures such as a crash, a stall or a refused permission are each handled.

actions.title: Build a session board to launch and watch actions
actions.why: Gives the operator one page for everything to do, with a launch control and live output.
actions.done_when: The board lists every operator item and ready Action with its project and plan, and a launched session shows its status, elapsed time and log tail, refreshed while it runs.

actions.title: Prove three live launches end to end
actions.why: Shows the path works on real providers repeatedly, not just once.
actions.done_when: Three consecutive launches of a small real Action each end merged to main, with no intervention between launch and merge, and the evidence recorded for each.

actions.title: Carry a launched pull request through review and merge
actions.why: Lets routine pull requests reach main, while stopping at any gate that needs the operator.
actions.done_when: A draft pull request from a confirmed launch passes an independent review, is repaired as needed and merges on green, and any gate needing the operator raises one item naming the pull request and reason.

actions.title: Launch the next ready action after each merge
actions.why: Lets a chain of Actions proceed without a manual launch for each one.
actions.done_when: Two consecutive live chains of two real Actions each run from one confirmed launch to both Actions merged, within a stated maximum number of Actions.
